title: Sightline: Long-Window Speculative Decoding for Fast SVG Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.23807v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) generation models write a graphic as code with one forward pass per token, so drawing is slow. Speculative decoding speeds them up losslessly, and block drafters guess many tokens per pass. On SVG, many of their rounds accept the whole draft and end only at the verification window. We find that their misses are rare and clumped, and that they stay accurate far deeper into a block than on natural language. A run-length identity and three propositions show that a longer window pays once the candidates are wide, up to the drafter's horizon. We propose Sightline, which pairs a window as long as the drafter's horizon with a draft tree wide enough to fill it. Experiments cover text-to-SVG and image-to-SVG with three models on six benchmarks from MMSVG, MMSVG-2M and SArena. In every setting, Sightline is the fastest of the compared lossless decoders. On SArena, it stays the fastest when every decoder shares one

translated_title: Sightline：用于快速SVG生成的长窗口投机解码
translated_abstract: 可缩放矢量图形（SVG）生成模型以代码形式编写图形，每个token需要一次前向传播，因此绘制速度很慢。投机解码可以无损地加速这一过程，而块级草稿器每次前向传播可猜测多个token。在SVG上，它们的许多轮次会接受整个草稿，并且只在验证窗口边界处结束。我们发现草稿的错误很少且呈聚集分布，并且在块内的准确深度远超自然语言场景。一个游程长度恒等式和三个命题表明，一旦候选足够宽，更长的验证窗口就会带来收益，其上限为草稿器的预测范围。我们提出Sightline，它将等于草稿器预测范围长度的验证窗口与足够宽以填满该窗口的草稿树相结合。实验涵盖文本到SVG和图像到SVG任务，使用三个模型在来自MMSVG、MMSVG-2M和SArena的六个基准上进行。在所有设置中，Sightline都是所比较的无损解码器中最快的。在SArena上，即使所有解码器共享同一个……（摘要截断）
tldr: Sightline通过将验证窗口延长至草稿器的预测范围并配合足够宽的草稿树，利用SVG生成中草稿错误稀少且聚集的特性，实现了当前最快的无损SVG解码。
en_tdlr: Sightline achieves the fastest lossless decoding for SVG generation by extending the verification window to the drafter's horizon with a sufficiently wide draft tree, exploiting the rare and clumped nature of draft misses in SVG generation.
